name: Amelia Virtual Care
one_liner: VR-based therapy platform for anxiety and phobia treatment
short_description: Amelia Virtual Care provides virtual reality-based mental health treatment tools for anxiety disorders, phobias, and PTSD. Uses immersive VR environments for exposure therapy and outcomes tracking...
long_description:
Amelia Virtual Care is a digital therapeutics platform that uses virtual reality technology for mental health treatment. The platform specializes in exposure-based therapies for anxiety disorders, specific phobias, PTSD, and related conditions.

The VR environments allow clinicians to guide patients through controlled exposure experiences that would be difficult or impossible to recreate in traditional therapy settings. This includes scenarios for fear of flying, public speaking anxiety, social anxiety, and trauma processing.

Amelia Virtual Care provides clinicians with tools to customize VR experiences, track patient progress, and measure outcomes across treatment. The platform combines immersive technology with evidence-based therapeutic approaches like cognitive behavioral therapy and exposure therapy.

The platform serves mental health clinicians seeking to incorporate VR into their practice, particularly those treating anxiety disorders and phobias. It requires VR hardware and clinician training to implement effectively, making it more suited for practices committed to technology-enhanced care.
best_for: Clinicians treating anxiety disorders and phobias
not_for: General therapy practices without anxiety specialty
Practices without budget for VR hardware investment
Solo practitioners seeking simple practice tools
